note: Collision Wrap rules for every City Breaker fighter (RmtWrapFit). merge: name prefix -> owner prefix (side and number kept), so finger bones count for the hand. ranks: lower holds, higher gives way in the Body Solve. radius_pct: the capsule radius is this percentile of the vertices' distance to the axis (just inside the skin). trim: share of vertices left off each end. min_verts: bones with fewer vertices get no piece. soft: pairs of part families that press like flesh (thigh into belly in a crouch, spine folding, chin to chest); the value is how deep they may go (world metres) before it counts as a clash. flat: a hub or end part whose cloud is this many times wider than thick becomes a row of thin capsules (a flat body). max_r: caps a limb's radius at this share of its length (by name prefix). chain: how many joints up a part may bend to get out (the part's own joint first); hips and root never bend. fighters: per-fighter overrides of any of these. max_turn: the most the Body Solve may turn a joint away from the clip (radians, by name prefix). spring_collide: spring chains (secondary.json) of these families bounce off the body's capsules.
